payload.text: A masthead's values come from the bundle and from the app. The bundle gives {name}, {version}, {commit} and {kind}, from its Info.plist's CFBundleName, CFBundleShortVersionString, ArcaCommit and ArcaKind, and a stamp that is absent, empty or not text gives no value. The app names the values it gives, once, each adding a value or taking the bundle's place, and is asked for those alone. A value it names but has not got yet is missing, whatever the bundle gives.
